summary: Modularize and harden logs conformance checker

delivery.outcome: Modularize standard/logs_check.py (2,271 lines) into <500-line cohesive modules under standard/ and harden strict JSON, O_NOFOLLOW/FIFO-safe bounded reads, lexical symlink-ancestor confinement, endpoint port/IPv6 checks, and unit test coverage.
nonGoals: No changes to pinned contract bundles, Protobuf schemas, or existing JSONL streams

architecture.decision: Factor standard/logs_check.py into logs_primitives.py, logs_subvalidators.py, logs_contract.py, logs_adoption.py, logs_events.py, logs_selftest_fixtures.py, logs_selftest.py, and test_logs_hardening.py while keeping standard/logs_check.py as the backward-compatible CLI and re-export facade.

validation.evidence: All Python files under standard/ are <500 lines after formatting, Ruff reports 0 issues, all conformance/unit tests and governance gates pass.
